beats.spoken_words: The second eye contact gets awkward with someone walking toward you,
beats.visual_description: Wide shot in an open campus quad. Two minimalist black ink stickmen walking in opposite directions directly toward each other. A red dashed laser line connects their eyes across the open distance.

beats.spoken_words: what’s the first thing you do?
beats.visual_description: Dramatic close-up on the main stickman's face. Eyes wide with cartoon spiral panic lines, giant yellow question mark above head, sweat beads flying off face.

beats.spoken_words: You whip out your phone,
beats.visual_description: Fast kinetic action shot: Stickman's arm whipping a sleek black smartphone out of his dark hoodie pocket. Dynamic curved speed arcs with bold hand-drawn text '*WHIP!*'.

beats.spoken_words: staring intensely at a blank screen like you got an urgent text.
beats.visual_description: Side angle shot: Stickman hunched forward, nose glued to his smartphone screen. The phone screen is completely black with glowing white digital text reading '00:00 - NO NOTIFICATIONS'.

beats.spoken_words: Be honest, we’ve all done it.
beats.visual_description: High-impact typographic punch card on textured paper. Bold black marker text reading 'BE HONEST.' and below in red ink 'WE\'VE ALL DONE IT.' with a small stickman covering his face in embarrassment.

beats.spoken_words: You spot someone twenty meters away, and your brain panics.
beats.visual_description: First-person perspective (POV) looking straight ahead. Another stickman figure approaching in the distance. A bright yellow measurement bracket spans the gap: '[ 20 METERS ]' with a pulsing hazard triangle.

beats.spoken_words: It’s too far to say hello,
beats.visual_description: Awkward demonstration: Stickman waving his hand stiffly from 20 meters away, with a tiny, ridiculous speech bubble '...hey?'. Red label at top: '[ TOO FAR TO WAVE ]'.

beats.spoken_words: but too close to pretend they don't exist.
beats.visual_description: Opposite awkward extreme: Stickman whistling with eyes tightly shut, head turned 90 degrees away, pretending the other person isn't 15 feet in front of him. Red label: '[ TOO CLOSE TO IGNORE ]'.

beats.spoken_words: If you stare at them the entire way, you look unhinged.
beats.visual_description: Creepy stickman face filling the frame with giant unblinking bloodshot eyes, terrifying wide frozen grin, and jagged black aura lines. Bold crimson stamp: 'UNHINGED'.

beats.spoken_words: If you stare down at your shoes, you look terrified.
beats.visual_description: Side profile of a crumpled stickman with head bent straight down at a 90-degree angle, eyes locked onto his cartoon sneakers, trembling posture. Bold blue stamp: 'TERRIFIED'.

beats.spoken_words: So you unlock your phone, pretending to check notifications that don't exist.
beats.visual_description: Close-up on cartoon hand rapidly swiping a cartoon thumb across a bare glass screen. Ghost notifications with zero badges floating in thin air. Comic sound effect: '*SWIPE SWIPE*'.

beats.spoken_words: Look, the other person watches you do it. They know you're faking—
beats.visual_description: Over-the-shoulder POV of the approaching stranger watching the main stickman furiously tap a blank phone. The stranger has a deadpan, unimpressed side-eye expression.

beats.spoken_words: because they were tempted to do the exact same thing.
beats.visual_description: Two stickmen approaching each other, both with identical thought bubbles above their heads showing a smartphone. Lightbulb ding effect above both heads: shared internal awkwardness.

beats.spoken_words: Here’s what to do instead.
beats.visual_description: Crisp high-contrast typographic card. Off-white textured paper with bold canary yellow highlighter bar behind black hand-drawn lettering: 'WHAT TO DO INSTEAD:'.

beats.spoken_words: Leave the phone in your pocket.
beats.visual_description: Stickman stands upright with hands resting casually in his dark hoodie pockets. The smartphone is shown inside the pocket with a green lock badge: '[ POCKET LOCKED ]'.

beats.spoken_words: Keep your shoulders relaxed, eyes focused on where you’re walking.
beats.visual_description: Full-body tracking profile: Confident stickman walking with smooth posture, shoulders dropped and relaxed, chin level, looking straight ahead into the distance with quiet calm.

beats.spoken_words: At three steps away,
beats.visual_description: Ground perspective shot: The approaching person is now close. Three clean footprint marks on the ground labeled '3... 2... 1...' with a golden zone marker: '[ THE 3-STEP ZONE ]'.

beats.spoken_words: look up, give an easy nod, and keep moving.
beats.visual_description: Dynamic medium close-up: Main stickman looks up smoothly, giving a calm upward chin nod with a golden curved action line. Calm relaxed half-smile, zero tension.

beats.spoken_words: It acknowledges them without forcing awkward small talk.
beats.visual_description: The two stickmen pass each other smoothly without stopping. Between them is a crossed-out red speech bubble filled with awkward words ('weather', 'hey man', 'plans?'). Zero disruption.

beats.spoken_words: No awkward staring, no fake texting, and no panic.
beats.visual_description: Triptych summary panel: 3 icons side by side. 1: Crossed out crazy eyes. 2: Crossed out glowing phone. 3: Green checkmark over a calm, relaxed stickman standing tall with hands down.

beats.spoken_words: Real confidence isn't hiding behind a screen—it's staying completely unbothered the second...
beats.visual_description: Cinematic final looping frame: Main stickman walking smoothly into the foreground with effortless composure, while far in the background another person approaches. Perfect seamless loop point straight back to Beat 1.
